description: Match a structured sleep profile to ranked products. Params: sleep_position (string|array: side|back|stomach|combination), pain_points (string|array: lower back pain|shoulder pain|hot sleeper|...), budget_min, budget_max (AUD), size, firmness (1-10), cooling_priority (bool|1-5), limit. Returns ranked matches with confidence + reasons + affiliate_url.
name: dome_match_profile
